subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed per-turn in untrusted prompt context, surfaced only to plugin hooks, or persisted on session metadata for later Conversions API reporting?
rationale: The extraction is bounded, but the requested field is an advertising click identifier and the issue asks for model/session visibility, so automation should not choose the exposure and retention boundary.

options.title: Plugin-hook attribution payload
options.body: Expose selected CTWA fields to opted-in WhatsApp/plugin hook metadata so a Conversions API plugin can consume them without automatically putting the click id in every model prompt.

options.title: Per-turn untrusted context
options.body: Expose selected CTWA/referral fields through the existing untrusted structured-context path and accept that the model can see them for that turn.

options.title: Persist session attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state only after defining retention, redaction, and access rules.

recommendation.title: Plugin-hook attribution payload
recommendation.body: Expose selected CTWA fields to opted-in WhatsApp/plugin hook metadata so a Conversions API plugin can consume them without automatically putting the click id in every model prompt.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent session metadata and structured-context work is the closest match for the product/security boundary decision.
